registration: local prospective protocol; not public preregistration
method_changes: Energy physical initial state only; atlas selection rule unchanged

energy.cost_scope: finite seven-day service; common endowed initial energy; terminal energy has zero salvage value
energy.archive_reuse: one frozen source archive per excluded geographic region, shared by its target markets and all arms using source outcomes
energy.temporal_audit: four chronological blocks, 512 evenly spaced starts, plus physically nonoverlapping starts; postdecision descriptive evidence
energy.inference: five geographic regions; algorithm seeds are repeats within markets
energy.cost: source calls counted once per geographic archive; target calls summed over actual markets; five seeds averaged within each market, not counted as five deployments

attribution.role: diagnostic comparison on previously used tasks
attribution.first_centers: source-best or the same structural medoid, independent of which metric is used
attribution.structural_metric: same standardized 18 cosine and diagonal-square coordinates as the current atlas
attribution.raw_metric: Voronoi quadrature weighted L2 over the same 128 reference nodes and the same public library
attribution.reuse: reuse original per-task outcomes only when the ordered profile IDs, family, task, design seed, resolution and evaluator are identical

confirmation.role: prospective confirmation on new family instances, source archives, public libraries and target tasks
confirmation.regimes: all eight original stress mechanisms, including failures
confirmation.primary_contrast: source_atlas minus standardized_generic_dct_maximin in certified true-feasible rate
confirmation.uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap replicates resampling tasks separately within each of the 24 fixed family-mechanism strata; report each family separately
confirmation.decision: retain a positive transfer claim only where the new paired evidence supports it; report reversals and failed mechanisms without retuning

theory: explain the measured roles of source first-center quality and structural coverage; do not assume transfer superiority or introduce a relevance gate without evidence
historical_results: preserved; corrected Energy and new comparisons are separate result artifacts
